title: West Kelowna with Wine Tour Guide, Cherry! Afternoon tours.
includes: Tasting fees are included at all wineries we visit.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
My West Kelowna Wine Route, which is a half-day wine tour, offers an incredible introduction to Okanagan wine country. The wineries, beautiful mountain views and a fun day touring and tasting at 4 wineries and vineyards is such a relaxing way to experience our area. All our tasting appointments are un-rushed and we offer our guests time to interact one on one with winery sommelier and associates. Guests enjoy 4-5 tastings at each winery as well as tasting notes and information about the history of the winery and each wine tasted. Also, we love to take pictures and can help capture this special time together!
Private tour option? Call me!
